description: Plataforma BIMBR is the Brazilian national BIM platform run by the Brazilian Agency for Industrial Development (ABDI), which hosts the national BIM library of building information model objects and a page of guides and standards. The guides and standards page read on 2026-09-28 summarises the Brazilian ABNT standards used for building information modelling, such as ABNT NBR ISO 12006-2:2010 on the organisation of construction information and the framework for classification tables, explaining what each standard defines for the architecture, engineering and construction industry. Coverage is Brazil. Access to the platform pages is free; the standards themselves are published by ABNT and are not free, and the licence of library objects was not read. Caveats: the object library contents and formats were not opened, and the page summarises, not reproduces standards. It supports digital twin and BIM-based asset models of Brazilian buildings and public works with national classification codes. Related record: platform-autodesk-tandem is a BIM-based digital twin platform that can use such objects.
